description: Corrections applied to data/ag_verb_paradigms.json before its cells are pinned as textbook forms. Removed cells are wrong for Attic (truncated, misaccented, garbled, or a non-Attic dialect form in a standard slot); a removed form that is a real dialect or later spelling can still enter the dictionary through corpus evidence. Added cells are standard forms the generator lacks, each corroborated by lookup.db listing it under the lemma or by corpus attestation in form_profile.db. A `withdrawn` block records review entries later found to be wrong, with the evidence that overturned them.

δίδωμι.δίδωνται: Wrong accent and vowel; present middle 3pl is δίδονται (subjunctive would be διδῶνται)
δίδωμι.διδοῖ: Ionic/epic contract form in the Attic present 3sg slot; Attic uses δίδωσι
δίδωμι.διδοῖς: Ionic/epic contract form in the Attic present 2sg slot; Attic uses δίδως
δίδωμι.διδοῦμεν: Contract form of διδόω, not Attic; present 1pl is δίδομεν
δίδωμι.διδοῦν: Contract infinitive, not Attic; present active infinitive is διδόναι
δίδωμι.διδῴη: Non-existent form; present optative 3sg is διδοίη
δίδωμι.δωσεῖ: Future is not contracted; circumflex on the ultima is wrong
δίδωμι.δωσῶ: Future is not contracted; future 1sg is δώσω
δίδωμι.δωσῶν: Future is not contracted; future participle nom m sg is δώσων
δίδωμι.δῴη: Koine/Homeric form, not Attic; aorist optative 3sg is δοίη
δίδωμι.δῴης: Not an Attic form; aorist optative 2sg is δοίης
δίδωμι.δῴητε: Not an Attic form; aorist optative 2pl is δοῖτε
δίδωμι.ἐδίδως: Wrong imperfect ending; Attic imperfect 2sg is ἐδίδους
δίδωμι.ἔδον: Epic short 3pl, not Attic; aorist 3pl is ἔδοσαν
δίδωμι.ἔδω: Truncated generator output; aorist 3sg is ἔδωκε

δηλόω.δηλοέτων: Uncontracted, non-Attic; the Attic present imperative 3rd dual contracts to δηλούτων
δηλόω.δηλοί: Wrong accent: the contracted -οῖ ending takes the circumflex
δηλόω.δηλοῦς: Not a form: -όεις contracts to -οῖς in the present indicative 2sg

λύω.λυέτωσαν: Post-classical 3pl imperative; standard Attic (Smyth paradigm) form is λυόντων
λύω.λυσομένα: Doric feminine nominative singular mislabeled as the Attic slot; Attic is λυσομένη.
λύω.λύ: Truncated generator output; present active indicative 2sg is λύεις.
λύω.λύε: Present stem has long ῡ, long penult before short ultima: λῦε
λύω.λύον: Neuter present participle, long ῡ before short ultima: λῦον
λύω.λύσαν: Wrong accent: long accented penult before short ultima needs a circumflex.
λύω.λύσεο: Epic-style form, not Attic; Attic aorist middle imperative 2sg is λῦσαι.
λύω.λύσον: Wrong accent: future participle neuter (and aorist imperative) is λῦσον, circumflex.
λύω.λυέσθωσαν: Post-classical 3pl middle imperative, the counterpart of λυέτωσαν below; standard Attic (Smyth paradigm) form is λυέσθων

παιδεύω.παιδεύον: Wrong accent: long diphthong penult before short ultima takes circumflex
παιδεύω.παιδεύσαν: Wrong accent on aorist participle neuter; long penult before short ultima needs circumflex
παιδεύω.παιδεύσον: Wrong accent on future participle neuter; long penult before short ultima needs circumflex
παιδεύω.ἐπαιπεδεύκει: Garbled reduplication/augment (παι-πε swapped); Attic pluperfect active 1sg is ἐπεπαιδεύκη

ποιέω.ποίοι: Garbled, wrongly accented present optative 3sg; Attic has ποιοίη (or ποιοῖ)
ποιέω.ποίοισιν: Garbled present participle dative masculine plural
ποιέω.ποιέεν: Garbled or dialect form, not the Attic present imperative 3pl
ποιέω.ποιέετε: Uncontracted Ionic form in the Attic slot; Attic contracts it to ποιεῖτε
ποιέω.ποιευμένου: Ionic ευ contraction; Attic has ου
ποιέω.ποιευμένων: Ionic ευ contraction; Attic has ου
ποιέω.ποιεύμενα: Ionic ευ contraction; Attic has ου
ποιέω.ποιεῖαι: Garbled present middle 2sg; Attic ποιῇ (or ποιεῖ)
ποιέω.ποιεῦν: Ionic ευ contraction for the neuter participle; Attic ποιοῦν
ποιέω.ποιησαμέναισι: Epic/Ionic dative -αισι in the standard slot; Attic -αις
ποιέω.ποιησεῖς: Doric contracted future; Attic future 2sg is ποιήσεις
ποιέω.ποιησοῦντι: Doric contracted future participle; Attic ποιήσοντι
ποιέω.ποιῆσθαι: Not the Attic present middle infinitive, which is ποιεῖσθαι (εε contracts to ει)
ποιέω.ἐπεποιήκεα: Ionic pluperfect 1sg -εα; Attic has ἐπεποιήκη (older) or -ειν (later)

τίθημι.θήσοίμην: Carries two accents; the future optative middle has only the penult acute.
τίθημι.θησεῖ: Wrong accent: this is a sigmatic future, not a contract future, so the accent is recessive.
τίθημι.θησεῖς: Wrong accent: sigmatic future, so the accent is recessive.
τίθημι.θησῶ: Wrong accent: sigmatic future, so the accent is recessive.
τίθημι.θώμεσθα: Poetic -μεσθα ending. The Attic aorist middle subjunctive 1pl is θώμεθα.
τίθημι.θῆαι: Not a real form. The aorist middle subjunctive 2sg contracts to θῇ.
τίθημι.τίθου: Poetic or later contracted present middle imperative (doubtful); the Attic form is τίθεσο
τίθημι.τιθέσθωσαν: Later -σθωσαν imperative (doubtful); Smyth's Attic paradigm form is τιθέσθων
τίθημι.τιθήμενον: Epic metrical lengthening, not Attic. The present middle participle is τιθέμενον.
τίθημι.τιθεῖ: Ionic/late thematic form. The Attic present 3sg is τίθησι(ν).
τίθημι.τιθεῖς: Ionic/late thematic form. The Attic present 2sg is τίθης.
τίθημι.τιθᾶσι: Not an Attic form of this verb. The present 3pl is τιθέασι, and 1sg τίθημι is already listed.
τίθημι.ἐτίθη: Athematic 3sg is non-Attic. The Attic imperfect 3sg is ἐτίθει.
τίθημι.ἐτίθης: Athematic 2sg is non-Attic. The Attic imperfect 2sg is ἐτίθεις.
τίθημι.ἐτίθουν: Koine contract imperfect. The Attic imperfect 3pl is ἐτίθεσαν.

τιμάω.εἶτε: Not a form of τιμάω; unrelated word (εἶτα/εἴτε), generator garbage
τιμάω.τιμάσαις: Doric ᾱ aorist stem; Attic aorist optative has η (τιμησ-)
τιμάω.τιμασεῦντι: Doric future 3pl mislabelled as the standard Attic slot
τιμάω.τιμησάτωσαν: Koine/late 3pl aorist imperative in -τωσαν; Attic form is τιμησάντων
τιμάω.τιμῆσι: Not an Attic verb form; present subjunctive 3sg contracts to τιμᾷ
τιμάω.τιμῷ: Truncated optative; 1sg present active optative is τιμῴην
τιμάω.ἐτιμάθης: Doric ᾱ aorist passive; Attic has η

ἵστημι.στήομεν: Epic uncontracted aorist subjunctive, not present subjunctive; Attic present is ἱστῶμεν
ἵστημι.στήῃ: Epic uncontracted aorist subjunctive; Attic contracts to στῇ
ἵστημι.σταθήτωσαν: Later -τωσαν imperative; Smyth's Attic 3rd plural is σταθέντων
ἵστημι.σταμένην: Attic ἵστημι has no second aorist middle; late Koine form
ἵστημι.στησάτωσαν: Later -τωσαν imperative; Smyth's Attic 3rd plural is στησάντων
ἵστημι.ἑστάκη: Doric pluperfect 3sg (Callimachus Hymn 5); Attic is εἱστήκει
ἵστημι.ἑσταότων: Homeric perfect participle; Attic genitive plural is ἑστώτων
ἵστημι.ἑστεός: Ionic perfect participle neuter; Attic is ἑστός
ἵστημι.ἑστηῶσι: Epic-type participle stem, not Attic; Attic dative plural is ἑστῶσι
ἵστημι.ἔσταθεν: Epic/Doric aorist passive 3pl; Attic is ἐστάθησαν
ἵστημι.ἔσταν: Epic/Doric root aorist 3pl; Attic is ἔστησαν
ἵστημι.ἕστατο: Doubtful: unaugmented pluperfect middle, unattested; expected augmented εἵστατο
ἵστημι.ἱστώμεσθα: Poetic -μεσθα ending; Attic prose subjunctive is ἱστώμεθα
ἵστημι.ἵστηται: Not the Attic indicative (ἵσταται); the subjunctive is ἱστῆται
ἵστημι.ἵστω: Not a form of ἵστημι; subjunctive is ἱστῶ (ἴστω belongs to οἶδα)

τίθημι.reason: Reviewed as post-classical ει-stem spellings of the perfect, which is wrong: τέθεικα is the Attic perfect of τίθημι (Smyth 777, LSJ s.v.). form_profile.db attests τέθεικα 46 times and τέθηκα 5, τεθείκασι 21 and τεθήκασι not at all. The generator now fills these cells with the ει stem and the removals would have taken the correct forms out of the pinned gate.
